text:
Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of y.
Participant(x, y) ::: x participated in y.
SixWayTie(x) ::: x is in a six-way tie on the leaderboard.
From(x, y) ::: x is from country y.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard of y.
AllOnLeaderboardParticipated(y) ::: All people on the leaderboard of y participated in y.
Premises:
Winner(steinhauer, duMaurierClassic1992) ::: The winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic was Steinhauer.
Participant(steinhauer, duMaurierClassic1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (SixWayTie(x) ∧ From(x, belgium)) ::: There was one six-way tie on the leaderboard and one person in the six-way tie was from Belgium.
From(descampe, belgium) ∧ OnLeaderboard(descampe, duMaurierClassic1992) ::: Descampe is from Belgium and is on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurierClassic1992) → Participant(x, duMaurierClassic1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Conclusion:
¬Winner(steinhauer, duMaurierClassic1992) ::: Steinhauer was not the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
